Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position. 
 
 Job Description:
 
 As a Software Engineer in Test, you will leverage technical expertise in automation, business domain knowledge, and data analysis to deliver high-quality, reliable software. You will partner with engineering teams to build scalable testing solutions, reduce risk, and ensure applications meet business expectations with consistency and confidence. 

 The Role  
 In this role, you will work with a team focused on improving product quality and delivery performance. You will partner with engineering and business teams to increase system reliability, reduce defects, and strengthen overall product health.  

 Key Responsibilities   
 Build and maintain automated test suites to validate product quality and release readiness  
 Execute targeted manual testing where it adds the most value  
 Enable teams with effective test management practices that improve delivery outcomes  
 Partner with engineers to expand test coverage and reduce defect leakage  
 Continuously improve testing strategies, tooling, and execution to increase efficiency and effectiveness  
   
 The Expertise You Have   
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).   
 3+  years of experience in test automation and software quality assurance.   
 Proficiency in automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress).   
 Strong programming/scripting skills (Java, Python, or JavaScript).   
 Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).   
 Familiarity with API testing (Postman, REST Assured).   
 Understanding of software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.  
 Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web, API, and backend systems.   
 Design and implement test automation frameworks using industry-standard tools.   
 Collaborate with developers and QA teams to identify test requirements and coverage.   
 Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality assurance.   
 Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and report defects effectively.   
 Maintain documentation for test cases, scripts, and automation processes.   
 Ensure compliance with quality standards and best practices.  
 High levels of engagement at the team and group levels; Desire to learn and impact outside your primary tasking.  
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders  
   
 The Skills You Bring   
 Excellent communication skills  and collaboration skills to work with multiple teams across the organization  
 Drive a strong quality practice and influence the team to focus on quality in each sprint  
 Continuously focus on improving stability and resiliency of critical business processes and applications  
 Ability to drive the test automation strategy within the team  
 Hands on experience with crafting and maintaining testing frameworks like Junit, Cucumber, Cypress  
 Intermediate Java skills  
 Good understanding of web services testing   
 SQL skills is a must  
 Data analysis and technical troubleshooting  
 Build efficiencies in testing that increase agility and time to deliver business value  
   
 The Value You Bring   
 Create efficiencies in testing that increase agility and time to deliver business value  
 Drive a strong quality practices and influence the team to focus on quality in each sprint  
 Continuously focus on improving stability and resiliency of critical business processes and applications  
 
 The Team   
 Within FFIO Quality Engineering, we partner with engineering teams across FFIO and Enterprise Technology to elevate product quality, improve delivery outcomes, and ensure systems are resilient, stable, and ready for scale.   
 Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model 
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.
